title: AI players in Unreal with contextual actions and animation triggers [Full tutorial linked in the post]
author: Western_Bug_5085

comments.author: pixelworld_ai
comments.body: I can't wait to go to an NPC and say "You are a helpful coding assistant, help me center this div"

replies.author: Western_Bug_5085
replies.body: The goal is less “ChatGPT inside an NPC” and more “a character that understands the world it’s in and can act within it.” :>

replies.author: eckstuhc
replies.body:
“Everyone on the ground this is a robbery”

Imagine GTA heists.

comments.author: Coretahner
comments.body: This is impressive. I'm really happy to see people pushing this. Though I feel like it's probably not quite there for most game Devs yet. It's getting to the end of the uncanny valley, it almost feels like your talking to someone who's got some learning disabilities.. Hyped to see where this goes. Keep at it!

replies.author: Western_Bug_5085
replies.body: Thanks, really appreciate it; we’re excited by how quickly this space is moving. Feedback like this is helpful as we keep improving realism, responsiveness, and how grounded these characters feel in actual gameplay.

comments.author: secretplum
comments.body: The character's voice doesn't match her at all. Cool feature but that was pretty distracting tbh

comments.author: WhopperitoJr
comments.body: Nicely done, always interested in what Convai is able to support. I work in this space with my plugin [Personica AI,](https://swamprabbitlabs.com/personica/) which is tuned for more general game use and local inference.
